author: Christine
description: A personal task list manager using Red's persistent Config storage.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores task descriptions provided by the user. Data is stored locally within the bot's Config and is not shared with any external services.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the Tasklist cog! Use `[p]task add` to get started.
name: Tasklist
short: Keep track of your tasks directly in Discord.
